name: KeyAccessControlRegister
tagline: Master key system, key issue and return, audits and lost-key rekey impact in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete key control app for facilities, property and security teams: a register of every key copy, fob and card; the master key hierarchy; issue with key agreements, approvals and contractor loan limits; returns, audits and off-boarding; and the rekey impact and cost when a key is lost or stolen. Runs in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Master key hierarchy from key code and parent code
Rekey impact: cylinders, doors, copies to re-cut, holders to recall, cost estimate
What-if simulation for any key code
Issue with signed key agreement, approver for restricted keys and contractor return dates
Loan limit, keys-per-holder limit, one copy per code per holder, no masters for contractors
Return receipts, extend, audit (sighted) with restricted audit cycle
Lost / stolen with police reference, found, rekey completed, credential deactivation
Bulk return, audit, extend, export CSV, delete
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts with bottom bar
Power Fx outputs and events, Dataverse direct save, Power Pages Web API
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
